name: Sister Pie
summary: Sister Pie was founded by Lisa Ludwinski in 2012 and opened its West Village storefront in 2015, becoming known for seasonal whole pies, slices, cookies, and scones. In May 2025, Ludwinski announced a period of rest and reconfiguration due to a financial crisis, closing regular retail hours on June 8, 2025. As of April 2026 the shop was open to the public every Friday from 7:30am to noon, with baked goods also available Wed through Fri at a nearby wholesale partner. Current status as of September 2026 is unconfirmed from a live official source.
hoursNote: As of April 2026 the shop was open Fridays 7:30am-12pm (or until sold out). Regular full-week retail hours have not resumed. Verify current schedule at sisterpie.com before visiting.
dietaryNote: Gluten-free cookies confirmed on April 2026 menu (Buckwheat Chocolate Chip GF). Vegan items confirmed (Caramelized Banana Muffin listed as vegan).
